faq.q: How much does Setareh Law, APLC charge?
faq.a: Setareh Law, APLC publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Setareh Law, APLC offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Setareh Law, APLC publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Setareh Law, APLC have offices?
faq.a: Setareh Law, APLC publishes three offices, in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Stockton. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Setareh Law, APLC?
faq.a: Setareh Law, APLC names eight attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Setareh Law, APLC publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Setareh Law, APLC publishes 35 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

json_ld_descriptions: Setareh Law, APLC is a highly accomplished personal injury law firm committed to helping accident victims throughout California recover full and just compensation. We aggressively advocate for the rights and interests of every client who has been injured in a car accident or other personal injury and handle each case on a contingency fee basis. That means you only pay a fee if we get you results. Setareh Law prides itself on unparalleled client service and being available around the clock for our clients. Getting the best possible results and never giving up are our top priorities.
